name: Speed Limits
description: Set maximum vehicle speed on city roads to reduce accidents and noise

name: Speed Camera Network
description: Automated camera enforcement of speed limits with variable fines

name: Drunk Driving Laws
description: Regulate blood alcohol limits for drivers and enforce through random checkpoints

name: Parking Regulations
description: Control on-street parking through time limits, pricing, and meter enforcement

name: Congestion Charge Zone
description: Charge vehicles entering the city center to reduce congestion and fund public transit

name: Low Emission Zone
description: Restrict older high-polluting vehicles from designated city zones

name: Bicycle Helmet Mandate
description: Require helmets for cyclists under a configurable age threshold

name: Building Height Limits
description: Restrict maximum building height to preserve skyline character and sunlight access

name: Setback Requirements
description: Mandate minimum distances between buildings and property lines for safety and light

name: Fire Safety Code
description: Enforce fire safety standards including sprinklers, exits, and material requirements

name: Earthquake Resistance Standards
description: Require seismic resistance ratings for new construction and mandate retrofitting of old buildings

name: Historic Preservation Ordinance
description: Protect buildings older than a threshold age from demolition and require sympathetic renovation

name: Industrial Emission Limits
description: Cap pollutant emissions from factories and power plants with regular monitoring

name: Noise Ordinance
description: Regulate permissible noise levels during day and night with construction hour restrictions

name: Recycling Mandate
description: Require households and businesses to sort waste into configurable recycling categories

name: Single-Use Plastic Ban
description: Phase out single-use plastics from bags to packaging with escalating scope levels

name: Green Building Requirements
description: Mandate energy efficiency ratings, solar panels, and green roofs for new construction

name: Carbon Tax
description: Tax carbon dioxide emissions per ton with configurable exemptions and revenue recycling to citizens

name: Minimum Wage
description: Set a minimum hourly wage with optional youth discount and automatic annual adjustments

name: Work Hours Limit
description: Cap weekly working hours with mandatory overtime pay and guaranteed rest days

name: Child Labor Ban
description: Prohibit employment of children under a configurable age with restricted hours for young workers

name: Union Rights Act
description: Protect workers' right to organize, bargain collectively, and strike without retaliation

name: Workplace Safety Standards
description: Mandate safety equipment, training, and regular inspections across all industries

name: Parental Leave Policy
description: Guarantee paid leave for new parents with configurable duration and compensation levels

name: Public Drinking Ban
description: Restrict alcohol consumption in public spaces with optional designated drinking areas

name: Public Smoking Ban
description: Ban smoking in enclosed public spaces with configurable outdoor buffer zones around entrances

name: Curfew Ordinance
description: Restrict movement of people under an age threshold during nighttime hours

name: Pet Ownership Regulations
description: Regulate pet ownership including leash laws, registration, breed restrictions, and waste cleanup

name: Homelessness Policy
description: Address homelessness through shelters, outreach, and housing-first programs at configurable scale

name: Drug Policy
description: Set drug enforcement policy from strict prohibition to harm reduction and decriminalization

name: Mixed-Use Zoning
description: Allow residential and commercial uses in the same zone to create walkable vibrant neighborhoods

name: Affordable Housing Quota
description: Require developers to include a percentage of below-market-rate units in new housing projects

name: Density Limits
description: Control development density with unit caps, floor area ratios, and mandatory open space

name: Parking Minimums
description: Require minimum parking spaces for new developments with reductions near transit stations

name: Industrial Buffer Zone
description: Mandate green buffer zones between industrial and residential areas to protect health and property values

name: Property Tax
description: Annual tax on property values, scaling with land and building assessments.

name: Sales Tax
description: Percentage tax applied to retail goods and services at point of sale.

name: Income Tax
description: Progressive tax on citizen earnings, with configurable brackets to shift burden toward higher incomes.

name: Corporate Tax
description: Tax on business profits, funding public infrastructure at the cost of reduced corporate investment.

name: Luxury Tax
description: Surcharge on high-value goods and extravagant properties, redistributing wealth from the elite.

name: Automation Tax
description: Per-unit levy on industrial robots and automated systems, slowing displacement of human labor.

name: Tourism Tax
description: Bed tax and visitor surcharge funding local infrastructure while mildly discouraging tourism.

name: Free Public Transit
description: Abolish fares on all public transit, funded entirely by city revenue. Massively boosts ridership.

name: Universal Healthcare
description: Government-funded healthcare for all residents. Higher tiers cover dental, vision, and mental health.

name: Free Education
description: State-funded education from primary through university. Level 1 = primary, 2 = secondary, 3 = tertiary.

name: Public Housing Program
description: Government-built affordable housing complexes. Higher quality tiers cost more but reduce crime further.

name: Unemployment Benefits
description: Safety net payments to citizens who lose their jobs, with configurable generosity and duration.

name: Universal Basic Income
description: Unconditional monthly payment to every resident, replacing most targeted welfare programs.

name: Press Freedom Act
description: Constitutional protections for journalists and publishers. Higher levels shield whistleblowers and sources.

name: Government Transparency Act
description: Mandatory public disclosure of budgets, contracts, and decision records. Higher levels require real-time open data.

name: Anti-Corruption Commission
description: Independent body investigating graft and bribery. Higher independence makes it harder for officials to interfere.

name: Digital Governance Platform
description: Move permits, voting, and public records online. Faster service but may exclude the elderly and offline population.

name: Participatory Budgeting
description: Citizens directly vote on how a share of the city budget is spent. Builds trust but may fund populist projects.

name: Data Privacy Act
description: Regulates how companies collect, store, and sell personal data. Strict levels require consent for every use.

name: AI Regulation Framework
description: Mandatory audits and restrictions on AI systems used in hiring, policing, and public services.

name: Autonomous Vehicle Code
description: Legal framework for self-driving vehicles. Higher permitted levels allow fully driverless operation on all roads.

name: Drone Regulation
description: Rules governing drone flights over the city. Enabling commercial use unlocks drone delivery but raises noise and privacy concerns.

name: Internet Content Regulation
description: State filtering of online content. Level 0 is open internet; level 3 blocks foreign platforms and enforces keyword filtering.

name: Religious Education in Schools
description: Include religious studies in the school curriculum. More faiths included increases tolerance but dilutes each tradition.

name: Public Arts Funding
description: City grants for theaters, galleries, and public art. Focus: 1 = traditional, 2 = mixed, 3 = avant-garde.

name: Heritage Protection Ordinance
description: Designate historic districts where demolition is banned and renovations must preserve original character.

name: Official Language Policy
description: Mandate official language(s) for government, signs, and schools. More languages cost more but welcome immigrants.

name: Media Regulation
description: Broadcasting standards and ownership rules for newspapers, radio, and television. Limits foreign media influence.

name: Vaccination Mandate
description: Require citizens to receive designated vaccines. Allowing exemptions reduces backlash but weakens herd immunity.

name: Food Safety Standards
description: Regulate food production, storage, and labeling. Frequent inspections catch problems early but burden small producers.

name: Air Quality Standards
description: Cap industrial and vehicle emissions. Strict standards dramatically improve public health but raise production costs.

name: Water Quality Act
description: Mandate water treatment and regular testing of municipal supply. Higher standards filter more contaminants.

name: Mental Health Funding
description: Dedicated funding for counseling services, crisis hotlines, and community mental health clinics.

name: Gambling Regulation
description: Controls on gambling operations. Level 0 = banned, 1 = restricted zones, 2 = licensed citywide, 3 = unregulated.

name: City Lottery
description: State-run lottery with proceeds directed to education or general fund. Cheap revenue but regressive by nature.
